tweet.text:
Bad news for ChatGPT users: starting in December, Plus, Pro and Business limits will be shared across ChatGPT and Codex.

OpenAI quietly updated its help page. Usage will now be measured in tokens, so bigger models and harder tasks burn through your allowance faster. Only Instant chat stays free of the limit. Hit the cap and you wait, upgrade or buy credits. Heavy Codex users may feel this one.
